query: 反歧视政策 反歧视政策 衡量企业在招聘、晋升、薪酬及日常管理中，针对消除基于性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等特征歧视的承诺、规则与执行机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：明确界定了受保护的多元特征（包含但不限于性别、民族、生理状况等）；且规定了面向全员的反歧视/DEI 专项培训要求。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的反歧视声明或包含在员工手册中，具备基础的公平雇佣承诺。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策披露，或仅有笼统的“依法合规雇佣”表述。 二、执行机制得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：具备匿名举报热线；有明确的违规调查处理流程。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：缺乏明确的举报渠道或未说明处理机制。 • 0分（无覆盖）：未采取实质性的合规管理行动。 反歧视政策 禁止就业歧视 受保护特征 公平雇佣声明 反歧视培训 无意识偏见培训 歧视投诉 歧视调查处理 多元与共融 anti-discrimination policy non-discrimination in employment protected characteristics equal employment opportunity employment discrimination anti-discrimination training unconscious bias training discrimination complaint discrimination investigation diversity and inclusion 企业是否有正式反歧视政策或公平雇佣声明？ 明确保护哪些特征（性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等）？ 是否要求全员反歧视/DEI培训？ 是否有匿名举报热线或投诉渠道？ 违规调查与处理流程是什么？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '反歧视政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否有正式反歧视政策或公平雇佣声明？ 明确保护哪些特征（性别、种族、年龄、残疾、宗教等）？ 是否要求全员反歧视/DEI培训？ 是否有匿名举报热线或投诉渠道？ 违规调查与处理流程是什么？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“依法合规雇佣”口号；仅有多元化人数统计而无政策；仅有客户反歧视营销政策；仅有反骚扰但完全不涉及雇佣歧视时可谨慎区分；区分：反歧视政策关注禁止基于特定特征的歧视及合规执行；平等机会措施关注选拔流程公平与监控指标；员工申诉机制是通用渠道， alone 不能证明存在反歧视政策。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: D&G strives to create a diverse and inclusive working environment to unlock employees' potentials. The Group adheres to the principle of 'openness, equality, competition and basis of merits', to formulate equal opportunity and anti-discrimination employment policy to promote diversity in the workplace. Throughout the hiring process, the Group prohibits any forms of discrimination based on gender, disability, marital status, race, religion, age, nationality and sexual orientation etc.

D&G strives to create a diverse and inclusive working environment to unlock employees' potentials. The Group adheres to the principle of 'openness, equality, competition and basis of merits', to formulate equal opportunity and anti-discrimination employment policy to promote diversity in the workplace. Throughout the hiring process, the Group prohibits any forms of discrimination based on gender, disability, marital status, race, religion, age, nationality and sexual orientation etc.

results.text: D&G believes employees are our greatest asset, and they play a key role in our business success. The Group's human resources ('HR') management is rigorous, which includes recruitment, promotion, transfer, salary and benefits, and training development. D&G has formulated an internal employment policy and fully protects the rights and interests of employees. At the same time, the Group is also eager to attract, cultivate, and retain outstanding talents that are consistent with the company's development philosophy, and grow together with D&G. To this end, D&G established the 'Youth Employment and Training Fund' to reimburse or subsidize the tuition fees of employees who actively study to obtain academic qualifications, obtain professional titles or improve business-related professional knowledge and skills.

D&G believes employees are our greatest asset, and they play a key role in our business success. The Group's human resources ('HR') management is rigorous, which includes recruitment, promotion, transfer, salary and benefits, and training development. D&G has formulated an internal employment policy and fully protects the rights and interests of employees. At the same time, the Group is also eager to attract, cultivate, and retain outstanding talents that are consistent with the company's development philosophy, and grow together with D&G. To this end, D&G established the 'Youth Employment and Training Fund' to reimburse or subsidize the tuition fees of employees who actively study to obtain academic qualifications, obtain professional titles or improve business-related professional knowledge and skills.

results.text: Good integrity and ethics are part of the core values of the Group. D&G encourages employees to be self-disciplined, with reward and punishment mechanisms and establishment of relevant management standards. Employees are required to attend regular training to understand the importance of occupational ethics to the Group. With the assistance of the Legal and Compliance Department (the 'L&C Department'), the Group has formulated policies to eliminate anti-competitive or monopolistic behaviour, and ensure that the Group's operations comply with relevant laws and regulations. During the reporting year, the Group has complied with the regulations related to anti-competitive behaviour, anti-trust and monopoly practices.

Good integrity and ethics are part of the core values of the Group. D&G encourages employees to be self-disciplined, with reward and punishment mechanisms and establishment of relevant management standards. Employees are required to attend regular training to understand the importance of occupational ethics to the Group. With the assistance of the Legal and Compliance Department (the 'L&C Department'), the Group has formulated policies to eliminate anti-competitive or monopolistic behaviour, and ensure that the Group's operations comply with relevant laws and regulations. During the reporting year, the Group has complied with the regulations related to anti-competitive behaviour, anti-trust and monopoly practices.

results.text: Sustainability Report 2020 D&G values the personal professional development of employees, encourages them to regularly enrich their knowledge and skills, to understand and keep up with changes in the industry. Therefore, the Group promises to provide employees with diversified and appropriate training opportunities and development plans, to stimulate their potential, improve the quality of employees, promote the steady development of business, and convey a sustainable corporate culture. To improve the overall professional level of employees, and formulate training strategies for the coming year, the HR Department is responsible for supervising, organising and implementing training plans. Besides, the Group would carry out an annual survey on employees' training needs based on the 'Employee Training Management Guidebook', and evaluate the training plans provided by all departments to construct training strategy for the upcoming year. In order to ensure the effectiveness of the training, the HR Department assesses the employees' training outcomes and effectiveness though different assessment methods, such as written test or live demonstration. The HR Department also distributes questionnaires to participating employees after each training to collect feedback, and takes it as a reference for improvement of future training plans. D&G's training plan is mainly classified into four categories, namely occupational health and safety, management and operation, professional knowledge and environmental protection. During the reporting year, D&G has arranged a series of training programmes covering these areas:
